items.title: Shelly Berg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: sitting me down with Art Tatum and Oscar Peterson, Bill Evans and Bud Powell

ctx.x: That’s a bit of a challenge.

Yeah. Well he taught me the first three chords, basically playing up from F minor, G minor, A minor and just back down. And I did that for a while, then he taught me [scats], so my mother must have gone crazy for about two weeks, I just played that up and down the piano, the first four bars of “That’s All” until he finally taught me [scats], and I got that other chord, and that was the next couple of weeks. So it was a slow process. That was the beginning. As I said there was always music in the house. My dad,…
down and saying, “Listen to this, what are you hearing,” and really just mentoring me along. And he still does.
